content.name: Iron-air grid battery
content.what: Form Energy is commercialising an iron-air battery designed to discharge for up to 100 hours.
content.how: Discharge oxidises iron using oxygen; charging reverses that reaction. Cells are combined into modules and grid-scale systems.
content.use: Multi-day electricity storage for the grid

sources.supports: Form Energy describes its iron-air chemistry, system structure and up-to-100-hour product design.
Company reports grid-connected test systems; stage label indicates pilot/early commercialisation, not mature fleet deployment.
